001
002package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
005
006/**
007 * Marks a node item as visitable by a {@link INodeItemVisitor}.
008 */
009@FunctionalInterface
010public interface INodeItemVisitable {
011  /**
012   * A visitor callback.
013   *
014   * @param <CONTEXT>
015   *          the type of the context parameter
016   * @param <RESULT>
017   *          the type of the visitor result
018   * @param visitor
019   *          the calling visitor
020   * @param context
021   *          a parameter used to pass contextual information between visitors
022   * @return the visitor result
023   */
024  <CONTEXT, RESULT> RESULT accept(
025      @NonNull INodeItemVisitor<CONTEXT, RESULT> visitor,
026      CONTEXT context);
027}
